hotspots.title: Vox 29N Campaign Launch & Remigration Push
hotspots.blurb: As Spain approaches its November 29 snap general election, Vox leader Santiago Abascal closed out campaign rallies in Valencia and across Spain with fiery attacks on Pedro Sánchez and the European Union. Right-wing outlets heavily amplify Vox's core themes of national sovereignty, anti-immigration enforcement, and potential governing alliance with the Popular Party.
hotspots.affect: The upcoming vote carries high affective stakes as right-wing media frames the election as an existential turning point to unseat Sánchez's left-wing government.

hotspots.title: Jordan Bardella Faces Explosive Antisemitism Scandal
hotspots.blurb: Rassemblement National president Jordan Bardella remains embroiled in intense controversy following investigative reports into alleged past antisemitic social media posts. Marine Le Pen and RN leadership have launched aggressive counter-attacks accusing journalists of violating judicial secrecy and carrying out a politically motivated smear campaign.
hotspots.affect: The scandal triggers intense media combat, combining defensive outrage from far-right figures with severe mainstream scrutiny over Bardella's past.

hotspots.title: Meloni Confronts Zelenskyy Over Uncoordinated Libyan Naval Strike
hotspots.blurb: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni held a tense phone call with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy after Ukraine conducted a military strike against Russian naval assets off Benghazi, Libya. Italian coverage highlights Meloni's insistence that European allies must be consulted and that Italian national interest must not be compromised by uncoordinated military actions in the Mediterranean.
hotspots.affect: The rift exposes friction between Meloni's nationalist defense of Italian sovereignty and broader Western backing for Ukraine's military operations.

hotspots.title: Swedish Government Crisis & SD Coalition Negotiations
hotspots.blurb: Sweden's political landscape is experiencing intense turmoil as the Center Party weighs supporting Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson, opening the path for a government heavily reliant on the far-right Sweden Democrats (SD). The potential deal has sparked deep internal rifts, tearful resignations within liberal factions, and sharp attacks over SD's expanding leverage.
hotspots.affect: Coverage is emotionally charged around perceived political betrayal and the normalized influence of the far right in Swedish governance.

hotspots.title: Jair Bolsonaro Hospitalized with Severe Intestinal Obstruction
hotspots.blurb: Former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro remains hospitalized in the ICU following treatment for severe intestinal obstruction and pneumonia, even as medical bulletins show slight improvement. Meanwhile, political tension escalated after Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino suspended R$ 79.3 million in parliamentary budget amendments tied to his fugitive son, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro.
hotspots.affect: The intersection of Bolsonaro's physical frailty and ongoing legal enforcement against his family maintains an intense grievance register across Bolsonarista channels.
